question: Detect germline SNPs and indels from exome sequencing data. Filter SNPs and indels separately and generate a tabix index for each.

files.eval_guideline: Indel variant records (CHROM, POS, REF, ALT, FILTER) must match the reference; caller header lines and INFO-field order may differ.
files.match_reasoning: Exact basename and extension match; both are bgzip-compressed VCF files containing filtered germline indels for the same chr21 sample.
files.strategy_reasoning: The guideline requires record-level agreement at the exact CHROM/POS and REF/ALT alleles while allowing header and INFO-order differences, so whole-file exact comparison is too strict. A zero-position window enforces exact coordinates and allele matching; the guideline additionally directs comparison of FILTER values.

files.eval_guideline: The file must be a valid tabix index for the companion VCF.gz file; internal byte layout may differ.
